title: CueFX stand-in render status (v2.3: GET /api/standin/{standin_id}, POST /api/standin?wait=0, contract/HTTP.md)
description: Where a stand-in render is. `status`: queued (waiting for the render queue), running, done (`result` is the standin_result), failed (`error` is the contract error). `element`: the state of element.mp4, built on its first request: none (not requested yet), queued, running, done, failed (request it again to retry).
